PA-H10.fact: Liesel Marr set the rope-works fire
PA-H10.summary: Wren Halloway arrives at the Anchor Inn in Greymouth, where she overhears Tobin accusing Liesel Marr of setting a fire. Sheriff Tom Marston then reveals that Samuel Blackwood, a respected member of the community, is the main suspect in the recent disappearances and the sabotage of the saltworks. Blackwood is arrested, and Wren is thanked for her efforts in uncovering the truth.

PA-H10.summary: Wren Halloway and Ada examine the possessions of a stranger found in the marsh. They discover a brass token, a letter in an unknown language, a silver locket with a name engraved on it, coins, and a map with a cryptic message. Wren and Ada discuss the stranger's possible connection to Edmund and decide not to inform the constable yet, instead opting to gather more information.
